name: smith-machine-zercher-squat.html
instructions:
1. Set the bar to somewhere between chest height and waist height, then load the weight you want to use.
2. Stand with your arms under the bar and your legs around shoulder-width apart.
3. Lock your hands together and rest the bar in between your forearms and upper arms.
4. With your back straight and eyes forward, push through your heels and take the weight off the rack.
5. Inhale, and slowly squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
6. Exhale, and push up through the heels to raise the bar back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for desired reps.
